title: Context Injection and Long-Horizon Reliability: Separating Duplicate Recognition, Local Processing, and Counter Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2610.20633v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon failures of language models are usually measured as end-task success or as a horizon length. We instead score, step by step, three components of a 400-step ledger task in which every step is easy in isolation and the model's own answers are re-injected into its context: recognising a record already seen 5 to 300 steps earlier, processing the current record locally, and writing a counter incremented at every step. On Qwen3-8B (non-thinking, 20 seeds, replicated on a second machine and backend), with every step scored component by component, two results hold. First, duplicate-recognition errors rise late in the episode -- from 0.0019 to 0.011 per step at risk across step 200 -- while the counter makes no error in 8,000 steps and local processing is descriptively stable; the rise combines long-distance recall errors and rising false alarms. Second, a block of irrelevant content inserted before each step makes the counter fail i

translated_title: 上下文注入与长程可靠性：分离重复识别、局部处理与计数器追踪
translated_abstract: 语言模型的长程失败通常以端到端任务的成功率或可完成的视野长度来衡量。我们转而对一个400步的账本任务中的三个组成部分逐步评分——在该任务中，每一步在孤立情况下都很容易，且模型自身的答案会被重新注入其上下文：识别一条在5到300步之前已经见过的记录、在局部处理当前记录、以及维护一个每步递增的计数器。在Qwen3-8B（非思考模式、20个随机种子、并在第二台机器和后端上复现）上，对每一步按组成部分逐一评分后，得到两个结果。第一，重复识别错误在回合后期上升——在第200步附近，每步风险从0.0019上升到0.011——而计数器在8,000步中未出现任何错误，局部处理在描述性上保持稳定；这一上升结合了远距离回忆错误和不断上升的误报。第二，在每一步之前插入一段无关内容会使计数器失效……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文将长程任务失败分解为重复识别、局部处理和计数器追踪三个组件并逐步评分，发现Qwen3-8B的重复识别错误在回合后期显著上升（结合远距离回忆错误与误报增加），而计数器几乎不出错，且每步前插入无关内容会导致计数器失效。
en_tdlr: By decomposing a 400-step ledger task into duplicate recognition, local processing, and counter tracking scored step by step, the paper shows that Qwen3-8B's duplicate-recognition errors rise late in the episode while its counter stays error-free, and that injecting irrelevant content before each step causes the counter to fail.
